# London Handstand Academy

> Handstand coaching, online and in London, run by Elliott Staley. One to one coaching through the London Handstand Academy app, fully online from anywhere, with sessions and Saturday classes in person at OverGravity Gymnastics, Arches 160 to 163, Sutton Street, Shadwell, London E1 0DB. Beginners to advanced: from a first kick up to freestanding holds and the press.

## Who
- Elliott Staley, founder and head coach (Instagram @elliottstaley; the academy is @londonhandstandacademy). Nearly a decade of handstand practice, blending yoga, calisthenics and movement coaching. Writes the programmes and reviews every form check himself.
- Suryava (@flying_with_strength), gymnastics and calisthenics coach, over eight years training and coaching gymnastics. Co-runs the classes.
- Beth Shum (@flexibility_matters), Chartered Physiotherapist.

## Coaching (prices in GBP, 31 October 2026)
- Custom programme, £120 a month: a questionnaire to see where you are, your own programme in the app with every drill filmed and cued, video feedback on your footage every two weeks, the programme adjusted every six weeks, and the full Handstand Ladder app included. Fully online.
- Weekly coaching, £300 a month, limited places: everything in the custom programme, plus a video assessment and a video call to start, video feedback every week, the programme adjusted every week, a video call every month to check progress, Elliott chasing you if a week slips, and first pick of London session times.
- Sessions in London on either plan: 60 minutes one to one at OverGravity, £70 for the first each month and £80 for each one after, up to five a month. The custom programme with one session a month is £190.
- Month to month, no joining fee, cancel any time. Details: https://londonhandstandacademy.com/handstand-coaching-london

## Other ways to train
- The Handstand Ladder app, free to start: a short quiz places you on one of six stages (Foundations, Wall Work, Pushing More, Take-Off, Freestanding, Press) and builds a session at your level, every drill filmed with cues. Foundations is free with no account. The other five stages are £10 a month with a free first week. On the web at https://londonhandstandacademy.com/app.html and on the iPhone App Store as London Handstand Academy (UK).
- Form checks: film a set and Elliott replies on video within 48 hours with the one thing to change. The first form check is free with an account. After that, form checks are a monthly subscription, £35 a month on the website, for up to 3 clips reviewed every fortnight with the whole Handstand Ladder app included.
- One off one to one session in London: £80 for 60 minutes, £100 for 90 minutes, credited to the first month of coaching if you join within 14 days. https://londonhandstandacademy.com/session
- All Levels handstand class: 90 minutes on Saturdays at OverGravity, Shadwell, with two coaches and the group split by level, from never been upside down to press and one arm. £25, booked and paid online. Dates: https://londonhandstandacademy.com/handstand-class
- A free 15 minute video call with Elliott to work out which fits: https://londonhandstandacademy.com/call
